comments.author: Sarah Chen
comments.text: Flagged by Missing Department rule. Vendor didn't provide department code. Also noting: vendor has no EIN on file and uses a PO Box address in Nevada.

comments.author: David Park
comments.text: Reviewed all three Meridian invoices (Jan 10, 18, 22). Identical amounts of $7,500 each from a PO Box vendor with no EIN. This pattern is concerning. Escalating to Maria.

comments.author: Maria Gonzalez
comments.text: Agreed — three identical invoices with no supporting documentation from a vendor we can't verify is a red flag. Placing a hold on further payments until we complete vendor verification. Sarah, please request W-9 and proof of business registration.

comments.author: Sarah Chen
comments.text: This $180K server purchase was coded to 6420 IT Operating (opex) but should be 1700 Computer Equipment (capex). The impact on EBITDA is significant.

comments.author: David Park
comments.text: Confirmed misclassification. $180K to opex instead of capex affects our EBITDA by the same amount. This needs a correction JE before close.

comments.author: Maria Gonzalez
comments.text: Correction JE is pending. Sarah, please prepare the reclassification entry: Dr 1700 Computer Equipment / Cr 6420 IT Operating for $180,000. Tag it to this transaction for audit trail.

comments.author: Sarah Chen
comments.text: Four invoices from Pacific Consulting this week, all just under our $5,000 approval threshold ($4,750, $4,850, $4,900, $4,925). Total is $19,425. Vendor was created only 2 weeks ago.

comments.author: Maria Gonzalez
comments.text: This pattern is suspicious — 4 invoices just under the approval threshold within one week from a brand new vendor. Requesting vendor verification before any further processing. David, please review the VP Sales authorization for this engagement.

comments.author: Sarah Chen
comments.text: This $75,000 accrual for Zenith Marketing Q3 deliverables appears to be a duplicate. An identical entry was posted on January 31 (JE-10015) and was never reversed.

comments.author: David Park
comments.text: Confirmed duplicate. The January 31 accrual (JE-10015) for $75K is still on the books. This February entry doubles the liability. Sarah, prepare a reversal JE for the February duplicate.

comments.author: David Park
comments.text: SOD violation: Emily Rodriguez both submitted and approved this $12,500 expense report. Our policy requires a separate approver for expenses over $5,000.

comments.author: Sarah Chen
comments.text: Late Friday wire of $48,500 to Global Tek Services — a vendor created just 4 days ago. No PO, no attachment. Processed by Mike Chen who doesn't normally handle vendor payments.

comments.author: Maria Gonzalez
comments.text: This needs immediate review. New vendor + large payment + no PO + Friday afternoon + processed by unusual user = multiple red flags. Mike, please provide justification and supporting documentation.

comments.author: David Park
comments.text: Noting: Southwest Office Supplies bank account was changed on March 10 by Emily Rodriguez. This $34,000 payment processed 4 days later is significantly higher than their normal range ($500-$3,000). Verifying with vendor directly.

comments.author: Sarah Chen
comments.text: AWS hosting invoice normally goes to 5100 COGS-Hosting. This month it was coded to 6420 IT Operating by the new preparer. Needs reclassification.

comments.author: David Park
comments.text: This $95,000 revenue recognition JE has a GL date of March 31 but was entered on April 2 — after the period should have been locked. This moves revenue into Q1 that should be Q2.

comments.author: Sarah Chen
comments.text: Saturday posting to Suspense account for $25,000. Source is unknown. Mike Chen entered this — checking with him on Monday.

comments.author: Sarah Chen
comments.text: Flagged as round dollar amount ($8,000). Reviewed — this is a legitimate annual software license true-up at our negotiated enterprise rate. Dismissing as false positive.

insights.name: Analysis Period Adjustment
insights.description: Detects pairs of transactions in subsequent periods that are reversals of each other.

insights.name: Cash Expenditure
insights.description: Flags entries where cash or cash-equivalent accounts are credited.

insights.name: Duplicate Amount
insights.description: Flags duplicate transactions by matching amounts with accounts and dates.

insights.name: Empty Text Field
insights.description: Flags transactions where all entries contain blank Memo fields.

insights.name: Cash to Bad Debt Conversion
insights.description: Flags entries with matching amounts from cash accounts found as debits in bad expense accounts.

insights.name: Change in Account Trend
insights.description: Flags entries with amounts deviating from expected trend over time.

insights.name: Complex Instrument
insights.description: Flags entries with keywords like fair value, swap, option in the Memo field.

insights.name: Complex Structure
insights.description: Flags structurally complex transactions based on monetary flow indicators.

insights.name: End of Analysis Period
insights.description: Flags entries in the last 10 days of an analysis period.

insights.name: Benford's Law Distribution
insights.description: Flags entries where first 2 digits deviate from Benford's Law expectations.
